Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Yes — damaged items are handled differently from normal returns.
Normal returns: Once an order has been delivered, returns are generally not accepted for change of mind or taste. 
Damaged items: These are treated as a shipment issue. You should report it within 7 days of delivery and provide:
• Order number
• Description of the damage
• Photos of the package and the damaged item
• Photo of the packing slip 
You’re also asked to keep the damaged item and packaging in the condition received while the issue is reviewed.
So in short: normal returns are usually not accepted after delivery, while damaged items are reviewed as a shipment problem with photos and details.
